feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: Trump says U.S. struck deal to take control of 65 billion barrels Venezuelan oil
entry.summary: President Trump is touting a new deal for the U.S. to access Venezuelan oil fields. Trump says it's a major boon for the American people, but it's unclear when they'll see the benefits.

entry.title: Scholar discusses Trump's claims of a new Venezuelan oil agreement
entry.summary: NPR's A Martínez speaks with Francisco Monaldi, director of the Latin America Energy Program at Rice University, about President Trump's claims of a Venezuelan oil agreement.

entry.title: At least 15 people missing after Grand Canyon flash flood
entry.summary: Several people are missing or unaccounted for after severe flash flooding in the Grand Canyon on Saturday caused significant damage.

entry.title: NPR spent 2 years tracking deaths from heat. We found a staggering hidden toll
entry.summary: An NPR investigation found that people in the U.S. are dying from heat much more often than official counts show. We explore the reasons why — and how lives can be saved.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: Trump says U.S. struck a deal to take control of 65 billion barrels of Venezuelan oil, U.S. and Iran resume exchanging strikes, funding at the top of the agenda as House reconvenes.

entry.title: Prince's estate releases posthumous album, 'Timeless'
entry.summary: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with music journalist Alan Light about the posthumous release of a new Prince album, "Timeless"

entry.title: Rescuers search for the missing after deadly flood along Nepal-Tibet border
entry.summary: China and Nepal continue to grapple with the devastation left by catastrophic flooding along the Nepal-Tibet border, as rescuers search for the missing and assess widespread destruction.

entry.title: U.N. worker shares what aid is needed as Nepal recovers from devastating flood
entry.summary: NPR's A Martínez asks the United Nations' resident coordinator in Nepal, Lila Pieters Yahia, what more is needed to aid flood victims there.

entry.title: Dry eyes are common among women. Here's why you shouldn't ignore it
entry.summary: Dry eyes are a very common chronic eye condition among women in perimenopause and beyond. Here's why you shouldn't ignore it.

entry.title: Closing arguments to begin in trial for man accused of orchestrating Tupac's murder
entry.summary: Closing arguments are scheduled for Monday in the trial of Tupac Shakur's killing. The rap icon was gunned down in 1996 near the Las Vegas Strip in a gang-related altercation.
